tagline: An old phone becomes a robot brain. Every workshop episode and build Short, in one place.

guides.title: The Build So Far
guides.body: The workshop turns an old phone into a robot brain. The first full episode gives it eyes, ears, and a brain in one sitting. The Shorts are single steps from the bench: teaching the brain to see in under a minute, training it with Teachable Machine, and why the phone in your drawer already qualifies.

guides.title: What You Need To Follow Along
guides.body: An old phone you no longer use, a browser for the free Teachable Machine site, and the episode open beside you. Every step on the channel is shown on the same kind of phone, so nothing here needs new gear.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
